description: The 100 most recently reported drug recalls in openFDA's enforcement reports: which firms, how serious (Class I: may cause serious harm or death; II: temporary or reversible harm; III: unlikely to harm) and why. A count needs an exposure: all recalls per route of administration are divided by the products listed per route in the NDC directory, with a 95% Poisson interval, so a route with many products doesn't look riskier just for being big. A firm's count has no such denominator here. Reports are weekly; openFDA data are not for medical decisions.
name: US drug recalls
